definitions.gloss: supplementary budget; revised budget; amended budget
definitions.explanation: A budget that modifies the original annual budget, typically passed to fund unexpected expenses such as disaster relief, economic stimulus measures, or policy changes that arise during the fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}した→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧。

⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}した→編成する：22370_henseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The government compiled a supplementary budget for disaster recovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拡充|かくじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|も}り{込|こ}まれている→盛り込む：13608_morikomu⟧。
examples.english: This fiscal year's supplementary budget includes an expansion of childcare support.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧ (correction, revision) and ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧ (budget). In Japan, supplementary budgets are common and often quite large, sometimes rivaling the original budget in scale.

The Japanese government typically submits supplementary budgets to the Diet (⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧) in response to natural disasters, economic downturns, or new policy initiatives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}する→編成する：22370_henseisuru⟧ (to compile a supplementary budget)
- {補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧ (a supplementary budget is enacted)
- {補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a supplementary budget)
- {補正予算|ほせいよさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧ (scale of the supplementary budget)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {補正予算|ほせいよさん}: supplementary budget (amends the original)
- {当初予算|とうしょよさん}: initial budget (the original annual budget)
- {暫定予算|ざんていよさん}: provisional budget (temporary, when main budget is delayed)
